g.text: Supplement 1 · Length versus finite cue duration
Five models × three tests · exact shared relative-20% basal checkpoint · unchanged scalar gates and recovery

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #43525b

g.text: deBelly uses fresh corrected preparations and independent endpoint commands
Both patches use a constant peak across all lengths; Goryachev K=64, peak=6.4. Gradients retain one constant physical slope per model.
Each positive duration restarts the original checkpoint. Full strength adds the 1% reversed initial-polarity band to the orientation gate.
Open markers retain failing field-tail flags. Censoring marks explicit tested limits; missing endpoints break lines. Native times and scales differ.
Data generated 2026-10-08T19:26:33.200718+00:00; producer finished. Every imported and fresh trial passed independent native-array audit.
